verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents several features that run on their own once enabled: automated bulk outreach campaigns, Voice AI interviews on the candidate's schedule, an automatic Notetaker, and Talent Matching triage. It also offers webhooks on events such as application created or candidate hired, plus an API to advance, move and reject applications, so external background automations can be built. However, there is no evidence of a native, user-configurable automation or workflow builder; custom autonomous automations appear to need developer work through webhooks and the API. Missing for 10: a documented in-product automation/trigger-action builder, user-defined scheduled background jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
